thread.post:
1/ Cash Flow Brief, Nov 11 ☀️

Hot inflation lifted December rate-hike bets and pushed Bitcoin lower.

What happened, why it matters, and what could happen next 🧵

2/ Politics: WSJ reports US aircraft left UK base RAF Mildenhall over an Iran threat. Ukraine peace talks reportedly resumed.

Why it matters: Oil and gas prices can jump on Mideast news.

Next: If Iran tensions rise, watch energy prices climb.

3/ October CPI came in hot. 2-year Treasury yield rose 17 bp; Kalshi gives ~97% odds of a December hike.
Why it matters: Higher rates mean pricier mortgages, car loans, credit cards.
Next: Friday's 8:30 AM PPI could boost hike bets if core runs hot.

4/ Stocks: Nvidia fell 5.5% Tuesday on an unverified report of CEO Jensen Huang's alleged Chinese intelligence link.

Why it matters: AI stocks sit in many retirement accounts.

Next: Nvidia reports Nov. 17. If the probe grows, AI stocks may slide more.

5/ Crypto: Bitcoin fell to about $73,700 after hot inflation data, with $723M in liquidations.

Why it matters: IBIT saw seven straight days of outflows, $1.66B total.

Next: If outflows continue, watch for more bitcoin pressure.

Not financial advice.
